_sheet: Items. One row per Escape the Backrooms object the player can carry. The model is the game's mesh.

_columns.name: str; English name
_columns.pickup_class: str; class of the map actors that become this item lying in the level
_columns.hand_yaw: float; degrees the mesh is turned in the hand so it points the right way
_columns.hand_size: float; length of its longest side when held, in blocks (the meshes are not all modelled at the same scale)
